steps.what: List stored results of sustainability initiatives

outputs: filed copy of signed viability methodology v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored results of sustainability initiatives in {BI}. The officer develops the methodologies to assess viability or success. A later job files the signed methodology in {DOCS}. A model does not declare an initiative a success.
tasks.previous_blocker: Success was argued from a fresh sheet of results.
tasks.still_hard: A method can be clear and still miss the result that matters.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides how viability is assessed.

ambition.what: Apply the signed methodology the week new results are posted.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the method, not on copying results.

reach.task: Score an initiative only with the signed method

unknowns: Who else must accept the method.
research_questions: How often an initiative has no stored result.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining method time is still the officer's design.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

steps.what: Show stored progress against program objectives
Ensure compliance with regulations and policies

outputs: filed copy of signed objectives review v1

tasks.design: A job shows stored progress and status against sustainability program objectives in {BI}. The officer reviews that progress for compliance with policies, standards, regulations, or laws. A later job files the signed review in {DOCS}. The view does not declare the program compliant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Progress was copied into a review pack before anyone could check it.
tasks.enabler_now: Objectives and progress are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A status can be on track and still breach a rule.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides whether the program complies.

ambition.what: Review compliance the week the progress view updates.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the rules, not on copying progress.

steps.what: Assemble stored financial and environmental rows

loop.purpose: Draft the impact report from stored financial and environmental rows.
loop.input: Stored financial rows and stored environmental rows.
loop.output: Impact prose in which every figure cites a stored row.
loop.check: Every figure matches a stored row.
loop.stop: Stop when a figure has no stored row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot decide which impact the officer will stand behind.

steps.what: Write the financial impact the officer will defend

outputs: filed copy of signed impact report v1

tasks.design: A job assembles stored financial and environmental rows in {ERP}. A bounded draft writes the impact report only from those rows and stops when a figure has no row. The officer checks every figure, holds editorial responsibility, and signs. A later job distributes that signed version from {EMAIL}. It is not sent as a regulatory filing unless the officer has confirmed the duty. A line with no stored source is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: Impact reports were written from memory, and a figure could have no row.
tasks.enabler_now: The financial and environmental rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The officer still has to stand behind the impact.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what is distributed.

ambition.what: Distribute a signed impact report the week the ledger closes.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the impact, not on retyping rows.

reach.task: Use only the signed impact report

evidence.claim: Digest [S1] is cited for drafts whose figures come from the system of record and which the owner signs.
Digest [S5] describes evidence linked to each datapoint, so a sustainability figure with no stored row is not reported.
Digest [S16] records a report that cited non-existent references and a fabricated court case, so a line with no stored source is dropped.
Digest [S12] says public-interest text needs a label unless a person reviews it and holds editorial responsibility, and Digest [S11] dates that duty from 2 August 2026.

Digest [S8] keeps that reporting duty for companies above 1,000 employees and EUR 450 million turnover, with transposition by 19 March 2027, and firms under 1,000 employees may refuse excessive value-chain requests. Digest [S9] notes simplified standards adopted 3 July 2026.

assumptions: Every figure cites a stored row.
The officer holds editorial responsibility before distribution.
Distribution is not itself a regulatory filing.
unknowns: Who the report is distributed to.
research_questions: How often an impact figure has no stored row.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining writing time is still the officer defending the figures.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

tasks.short: Write grant applications for environmental funding.

steps.what: State the funding ask for environmental initiatives
List stored project rows for funding
Draft grant applications from project rows

loop.purpose: Fill grant figures from stored project rows and the officer's ask.
loop.input: The officer's ask and stored project rows.
loop.output: A grant draft in which every figure cites a project row.
loop.check: Every figure matches a stored project row.
loop.stop: Stop when a figure has no project row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A form fill cannot write the funding case the officer must own.

steps.what: Write project proposals to pursue funding
Sign funding documents for environmental initiatives

outputs: filed copy of signed grant application v1

tasks.design: The officer states the funding ask. A job lists stored project rows in {PROJECT}. A bounded draft fills grant figures only from those rows and the ask, and stops when a figure has no row. The officer writes the project proposals and other funding documents, signs them, and a later job sends that signed application from {EMAIL}. It does not submit an unsigned application.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grant figures were typed from memory into the form.
tasks.enabler_now: The project rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The funding case still belongs to the officer.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what is asked and signs it.

ambition.what: Send a signed application the week the project rows are complete.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the case, not on retyping project rows.

reach.task: Supply only rows the application cites

evidence.claim: Digest [S1] is cited for drafts whose figures come from the system of record and which the owner signs.
Digest [S16] records a report that cited non-existent references and a fabricated court case, so a line with no stored source is dropped.

assumptions: Every grant figure cites a stored project row.
The officer signs before the send.
unknowns: Which funder the application is for.
research_questions: How often a grant figure has no project row.
